config.description:
The declarative configuration file (providers, defaults, tenants with their
installations and repositories). Either inline as `file`, rendered into a
chart-managed ConfigMap, or an existing ConfigMap with a `config.yaml` key.
Secret material never goes in the file: it references files under
`secretMounts` or environment variables. Every replica re-reads the file on
`reloadInterval`; the leader applies it to the store.

existingConfigMap.description: Existing ConfigMap holding the file under the `config.yaml` key; takes precedence over `file`.
existingConfigMap.title: existingConfigMap

extraEnv.description: Extra raw env vars merged into every role's container (advanced).
extraEnv.title: extraEnv

file.description: (required unless `existingConfigMap` is set) The configuration file, as YAML. Passed through verbatim, not tpl'd. See the README for the schema.
file.title: file

indexWorkers.description: Index jobs one worker replica runs at once (KRITIK_INDEX_WORKERS), rate-limited apart from reviews.
indexWorkers.title: indexWorkers

logLevel.description: Log level: debug, info, warn or error.
logLevel.title: logLevel

onboardWindow.description: Onboarding index jobs the leader keeps queued or running at once (KRITIK_ONBOARD_WINDOW); tenants take turns and the most active repositories go first.
onboardWindow.title: onboardWindow

pollInterval.description: How often the leader lists each installation's open pull requests as a backstop for missed webhooks (Go duration); "0" disables.
pollInterval.title: pollInterval

pollLookback.description: How far back a first or long-idle poll looks (Go duration).
pollLookback.title: pollLookback

reloadInterval.description: How often each replica re-reads the file (Go duration).
reloadInterval.title: reloadInterval

reviewWorkers.description: Review jobs one worker replica runs at once (KRITIK_REVIEW_WORKERS); follow-ups share the count. A review or index job holds at most one runner pod, so runner pods never exceed the replicas working jobs × (reviewWorkers + indexWorkers).
reviewWorkers.title: reviewWorkers

config.title: config

dashboard.description:
KRITIK_DASHBOARD_KEY is the AES-256 key that seals every dashboard-managed
tenant's credentials (installation tokens, App keys, webhook secrets) at
rest; it has nothing to do with sessions. Wired onto every non-runner role
and required there once a dashboard tenant exists. To rotate it, move the
old value into oldKeysSecret (KRITIK_DASHBOARD_OLD_KEYS), which only opens
values sealed under it, and keep it there until every value has been
written again. Losing a key that still seals a value makes those
credentials unreadable, and the pod then fails to start.

name.description: Secret holding the key that seals dashboard tenants' credentials (`openssl rand -base64 32`); rotate via oldKeysSecret, as losing it makes those credentials unreadable and the pod fail to start.
name.title: name

name.description: (optional) Secret holding retired sealing keys, comma-separated, only to open values sealed under them.
name.title: name

dashboard.title: dashboard

database.description:
Three Postgres connection strings, each from its own Secret. The
application role must not own the tables (row-level security), the owner
role runs migrations and applies configuration on the leader, and the
runner role is handed to runner Jobs and can only write its own run. On
CloudNativePG, declare `app` and `runner` under `spec.managed.roles` and
use the bootstrap owner as `owner`; see the README.

existingSecret.description: (required) Secret holding the application role's connection URI.
existingSecret.title: existingSecret

role.description: Name of the application role, asserted at startup (not superuser, no BYPASSRLS, owns nothing).
role.title: role

existingSecret.description: (required for roles.all / roles.worker) Secret holding the owner role's connection URI, used only by the leader for migrations and configuration sync.
existingSecret.title: existingSecret

existingSecret.description: (required for roles.all / roles.worker) Secret holding the runner role's connection URI; referenced by runner Jobs, never read by the worker.
existingSecret.title: existingSecret

role.description: Name of the runner role, granted only what runner Jobs need.
role.title: role

database.title: database

deploymentAnnotations.description: Annotations added to every Deployment (e.g. `reloader.stakater.com/auto: "true"`). Pod-level annotations go in `podAnnotations`.
deploymentAnnotations.title: deploymentAnnotations

embedding.description:
The deployment-wide embedder that builds the vector index and powers the
similar-code context stage. All of `baseUrl`, `model`, `dims` and a key must
be set together; leaving `model` empty turns indexing off and reviews run
without vector retrieval. Changing model or dims later is refused unless
`reindexOnModelChange` is set, because it rebuilds every repository.

apiKey.description: API key, rendered into a chart-managed Secret. Prefer `existingSecret`.
apiKey.title: apiKey

baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint (OpenRouter serves Voyage's code models).
baseUrl.title: baseUrl

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret holding the API key.
existingSecret.title: existingSecret

maxItemChars.description: Max characters per input; longer inputs are truncated.
maxItemChars.title: maxItemChars

model.description: Embedding model id; empty disables indexing.
model.title: model

reindexOnModelChange.description: Rebuild the index when the model or dimension changes instead of refusing to start.
reindexOnModelChange.title: reindexOnModelChange

embedding.title: embedding

Agentic reviews are refused without it.

image.description:
Default values for kritik.

Most string, list and map values below are rendered through Helm's `tpl`, so
they may carry template expressions that resolve at install time, e.g.
  ingress.hosts[0].host: kritik.{{ .Values.global.domain }}
Plain numbers and booleans, and `config.file`, are passed through as they are.

networkPolicy.description:
NetworkPolicies (off by default): one for the service pods (ingress to the
webhook and metrics ports; egress to DNS, the forges and models over the
egress ports, and Postgres) and one for runner pods (egress only: DNS, the
git remote over the egress ports, and Postgres). The Postgres port is
allowed to any peer because the database may live in another namespace.

egressPorts.description: TCP ports the service pods may egress to for forges and model endpoints. Runner pods get these only when the gateway is disabled; with it, they reach the gateway alone.
egressPorts.title: egressPorts

maxUnavailable.title: maxUnavailable

priorityClassName.title: priorityClassName

create.title: create

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe, on the metrics port. A replica is ready once it has a database connection and its listeners are up.
readinessProbe.title: readinessProbe

resources.title: resources

roles.description:
kritik is one binary with three roles. `all` runs ingest and worker in one
process (the usual shape); a split topology enables `ingest` and `worker`
separately and scales each. Every enabled role renders its own Deployment
from the same image, config and secrets. Runner pods are not a role here:
the worker creates them as Jobs per review and index.

enabled.description: Run the single-process topology: webhooks, leader duties and the worker in one Deployment.
enabled.title: enabled

replicas.description: Replicas. Any replica can serve webhooks and work jobs; exactly one holds the leader lock at a time.
replicas.title: replicas

resources.title: resources

enabled.title: enabled

enabled.title: enabled

runner.description:
Runner Jobs: one pod per review or index run, created by the worker in the
release namespace from the same image, running as a service account with
no permissions and a database role that can only touch its own run. The
worker's Role reaches every Secret in the release namespace, so install
kritik into a namespace of its own.

deadline.description: Default active deadline for a runner Job (Go duration); tenants may lower it in the file.
deadline.title: deadline

image.description: Image for runner Jobs; empty uses the chart's image. The release's `-tools` tag (e.g. `ghcr.io/home-operations/kritik:1.2.3-tools`) adds curl, fd and rg for an agentic review's `agent.commands`.
image.title: image

runtimeClassName.description: RuntimeClass for runner Jobs (e.g. `gvisor`, `kata`). Advised: a runner parses untrusted repository content and, in agentic mode, runs what the model asks; a sandboxed runtime keeps it from the node's kernel. Empty uses the cluster default.
runtimeClassName.title: runtimeClassName

Secrets mounted as files for the configuration file to reference.
